# League v1 compatibility fixture

`league-v1-profile.json` is a synthetic max-profile produced by the previous LEAGUE-01 runtime at PR #4 baseline a57ceabc8570e57c0fcbf8aabdd5ee74674a7147 (`tools/league22-model.mjs`). Contains own puzzle IDs, fake profile and 515 ordinary contributions; no personal data. It freezes v1 plans/checksum/names/policy for a real old-format restore test. Do not regenerate this fixture with v2.

`league-v2-profile.json` freezes the prior v2 maximum-profile. `league-v2-active-win.json` and `league-v2-closed-win.json` were generated by the original v2 code at 5e465c9a (runtime-identical to 8ac5dc66), using GameSession settlement, a real valid completed field and the existing writer. They preserve the +10 ordinary win, point receipt, and an already-presented weekly medal. All profiles are synthetic and contain no personal data.
